title: Columbia University Taiwanese American Students Association
content_html:
The Columbia University Taiwanese American Students Association (CU TASA) is an undergraduate organization at Columbia University dedicated to building a community for individuals interested in Taiwanese culture. It is recognized as an official student group under Columbia College and Columbia Engineering’s Activities Board.

CU TASA describes its purpose as providing students a home to foster interest in the Taiwanese American community and form lasting friendships. Its programming includes intercultural forums, movie screening events, and social bonding activities designed to help members explore and engage with their cultural identities. One of its signature recurring events is “Night in Taiwan,” an annual celebration of Taiwanese culture held on campus featuring food from local Taiwanese restaurants.

CU TASA is affiliated with the Intercollegiate Taiwanese American Students Association (ITASA) East Coast network, which connects Taiwanese American student groups across universities on the East Coast. The organization maintains an active presence on Instagram (@tasa_cu) and Facebook, and its official website is hosted on Columbia University’s blog platform.
